6.

The present FIR bearing no. 0703/2021 was got registered on the basis of the complaint made by the respondent no. 2 under sections 406/498A/34 IPC at P.S. Kalkaji wherein the petitioners were implicated.
The petitioners no. 2 to 5 are the family members/relatives of the petitioner no. 1.

The petitioner no. 1, who appeared in person and the petitioners no. 2 to 5, who are appearing through video-conferencing and the respondent no.2 are identified by the Investigating Officer SI Ravi Kumar, P.S. Kalkaji and by their respective counsel.
The investigation is still pending and the charge-sheet has not been filed.

7. The petition under section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 bearing no. 832/2021 was referred to Delhi Mediation Centre, Saket Courts, Delhi whereby the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have settled their pending disputes vide Settlement dated 21.12.2022 whereby they have agreed to dissolve their marriage by way of decree of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13 (B) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

The petitioner no. 1 has already paid Rs.15,00,000/- to the respondent no. 2, which is acknowledged by the respondent no. 2.

The petitioner no. 1 also delivered a demand draft bearing no. 414023 dated 08.11.2023 drawn on State Bank of India amounting to Rs.5,00,000/- towards payment of balance settled amount to the respondent no. 2, which is accepted by the respondent no. 2.
8.

The marriage between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 has already been dissolved by way of decree of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13B (2) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 in petition bearing HMA no. 196/2023 vide judgment dated 28.03.2023 passed by the court of Sh.
Rajneesh Kumar, PJFC, South District, Saket Courts, Delhi.

9. The counsel for the petitioners stated that the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have settled their disputes vide Settlement dated 21.12.2022, the terms and conditions of which have already been executed.

The marriage between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 has already been dissolved as such, the present petition be allowed and FIR bearing no. 0703/2021 be quashed along with consequential proceedings.
